feed.title: FedEx-led Group Buys InPost for €7.8B
feed.summary: A consortium led by FedEx Corp. and Advent International has successfully completed a €7.8 billion tender offer for InPost SA, acquiring 89.8% of its shares. InPost's founder and CEO, Rafal Brzoska, will remain at the helm, and the deal is expected to lead to cheaper and simpler deliveries for online shoppers.

feed.title: Bank Of Montreal (TSX:BMO) Drops Trading Fees For Self Directed Investors
feed.summary: Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) has announced that BMO InvestorLine will eliminate commissions on all stocks and ETFs for self-directed clients, becoming the first major Canadian institution to do so. The bank will also remove administrative fees for these accounts, aligning with its strategy to deepen client engagement through digital platforms and fee-based services. This move aims to compete with low-cost platforms and bolster BMO's digital-first banking narrative, though it pressures one revenue stream and increases reliance on advisory, payments, and capital-markets income.

feed.title: Huntington Bancshares Cuts 2027 Outlook as Margin, Loan Growth Pressures Mount
feed.summary: Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) has lowered its 2027 EPS outlook to $1.75–$1.83, citing increased funding costs, deposit competition, and reduced loan growth.
